description: Update an existing AbaNinja invoice by uuid. Pass only what should change; positions replace the existing ones when given, and the total is then recomputed by AbaNinja. Does not send anything. A invoice that AbaNinja considers final may refuse the change — the API's error is passed through unchanged rather than swallowed.

positions.description: If given, replaces all line items.

uuid.description: AbaNinja uuid of the invoice to update

name: update_abaninja_invoice
